citations.claim: first pole_upright violation: theta -0.819 rad exceeds 0.8 limit, controller saturated at 20
one step before violation pole was still inside limit at theta -0.764
during push pole already falling fast with omega -3.53 rad/s and theta -0.35

explanation: Fast unstable plant (short 0.3m heavy 0.5kg pole, gravity 15) at coarse dt 0.02 destabilized further by 10N 0.2s push: pole gains large negative rate (~-3.5 rad/s at step 30) and angle, controller saturates at force_limit 20 (steps 36-37) and cannot catch the fall, so theta crosses 0.8 rad to -0.819 at step 37.
vision_note: The pole leans increasingly to the left across steps 34 to 36 while the cart remains near the track center. At step 37 the pole tip turns red showing the pole has fallen past the upright limit.
